# Wanlian Fluid Equipment

Quanzhou Wanlian Fluid Equipment Co., Ltd. is located in Quanzhou, Fujian — the starting point of the Maritime Silk Road and the core cluster of China's plumbing and valve industry. As a professional fluid-equipment enterprise integrating R&D, sales and service, we focus on providing high-quality valves, supporting fire-fighting equipment, fluid-control equipment and integrated solutions for industrial, municipal, fire-protection, water supply and drainage sectors. Our cooperative manufacturing bases strictly control production procedures in accordance with the ISO9001 Quality Management System, ensuring the stability, reliability and durability of each product. We also supply supporting fire-fighting equipment including fire cabinets, fire hydrants, fire extinguishers, fire hose reels, hoses, nozzles, couplings and sprinklers, with OEM, ODM and non-standard customization services.

## Core Products
- **Valves & Parts**: Resilient seat gate valves (Z41X), butterfly valves, ball check valves, Y-strainers.
- **Fire Protection**: Indoor/outdoor fire hydrants (SN65, SSFT100), wet alarm check valves (ZSFZ), fire water cannons (ZDMS, PS).
- **Hydraulic Safety**: Water level control valves (F745X), pressure reducing valves (500X), electromagnetic flow meters.

## Cooperation Scope
- **Product Selection**: Support for matching valve and fire protection products to project requirements.
- **Technical Information**: Product specifications, dimensions, materials, and application details are provided on relevant product pages.
- **B2B Cooperation**: OEM/ODM requirements, documentation, packaging, and shipping details can be discussed through an inquiry.
